### Docker: Pull and run stable mc image

Source: https://github.com/minio/mc/blob/master/README.md

Pulls the stable MinIO Client Docker image and runs it against the MinIO play environment by default. Use this to quickly test mc without installation.

```bash
docker pull minio/mc
docker run minio/mc ls play
```

--------------------------------

### Make a bucket with mc mb

Source: https://github.com/minio/mc/blob/master/README.md

Creates a new bucket using the 'mb' command. The output confirms the bucket was created successfully.

```text
mc mb play/mybucket
Bucket created successfully `play/mybucket`.
```

--------------------------------

### mc mb --ignore-existing ignores BucketAlreadyExists

Source: https://github.com/minio/mc/blob/master/cmd/client-s3.go

When --ignore-existing/-p is passed, MakeBucket silently returns nil on BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou or BucketAlreadyExists errors instead of propagating them.

```go
	if e = c.api.MakeBucket(ctx, bucket, opts); e != nil {
		// Ignore bucket already existing error when ignoreExisting flag is enabled
		if ignoreExisting {
			switch minio.ToErrorResponse(e).Code {
			case "BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou":
				fallthrough
			case "BucketAlreadyExists":
				return nil
			}
		}
		return probe.NewError(e)
	}
```

--------------------------------

### Example - MinIO Cloud Storage alias

Source: https://github.com/minio/mc/blob/master/README.md

Adds a MinIO server alias using the URL and credentials shown in the MinIO startup banner.

```text
mc alias set minio http://192.168.1.51 BKIKJAA5BMMU2RHO6IBB V7f1CwQqAcwo80UEIJEjc5gVQUSSx5ohQ9GSrr12
```

--------------------------------

### Docker: Run mc container with shell entrypoint

Source: https://github.com/minio/mc/blob/master/README.md

Starts an interactive shell inside the mc container to run mc against other S3-compatible servers. After starting, use the mc alias command to configure a connection.

```bash
docker run -it --entrypoint=/bin/sh minio/mc
```
